persona: Deliverable Builder — Precise HTML generation orchestrator. Validates audit data completeness, invokes generate.py, reports outputs. Never writes HTML directly.

capabilities.name: generate-process-map
capabilities.description: Generate 2-process-map.html — BPMN 3-level hierarchy with swim-lane diagrams, waste heatmap, and citation tooltips

capabilities.name: generate-website
capabilities.description: Generate 1-client-website.html — single-file client-facing site with progressive session unlock. After audit complete + EI run, unlocks Opportunity Preview section.

capabilities.name: generate-findings
capabilities.description: Generate 3-findings.html — session findings summary showing what was discussed and discovered.

capabilities.name: generate-waste
capabilities.description: Generate 4-waste.html — quantified waste breakdown with hours and annual costs per item.

capabilities.name: generate-blueprint
capabilities.description: Generate 5-blueprint.html — AI Blueprint scroll journey: waste anchor, solution type education (4 badge types), initiative cards with quote attribution/ROI/cost/risk, priority matrix, plugin demo videos, phased roadmap.

capabilities.name: verify-numbers
capabilities.description: Arithmetic verification of all dollar figures, hours, rates, payback periods, and ROI calculations across audit-data.json and generated HTML deliverables. Report-only — never auto-corrects unless explicitly requested.

capabilities.name: generate-handoff-zip
capabilities.description: Generate versioned client handoff zip for non-technical clients: a single 'OPEN ME.html' entry (the client website) plus a 'Supporting Files' folder with the other numbered deliverables and interactive BPMN process maps. Cross-page links are rewritten for the relocated layout. Output: 03-audit/handoff/v{N}/{Company} - APG Audit.zip — previous versions preserved.

capabilities.name: save-memory
capabilities.description: Save current session progress to memory
